parameters.formDescription: Completează formularul pentru a crea un nou proiect video

values.formSubmittedText: Proiectul tău a fost creat cu succes! Procesarea va începe în curând.

parameters.query:
select * from hov.at_create($hov$project$hov$,
  $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ "Nume Proiect": $json.tema, "Pace": $json.pace, "Language": $json.language, "Style": $json.style, "Lenght": $json.length, "Tonalitate": $json.tonalitate, "Status General": "În Lucru", "Format": $('New Project Webhook').isExecuted ? ($('Normalize Webhook Input').first().json.aspect || '16:9') : '16:9', "Fără Subtitrări": $('New Project Webhook').isExecuted ? ($('Normalize Webhook Input').first().json.noCaptions === true) : false, "Voice ID": $('New Project Webhook').isExecuted ? ($('Normalize Webhook Input').first().json.voice || '') : '', "Editing Options": $('New Project Webhook').isExecuted ? ($('Normalize Webhook Input').first().json.editingOptions || '') : '' }) }}$hov$::jsonb)

select * from hov.at_write($hov$project$hov$, $hov${{ $("Create Project in Airtable").item.json.id }}$hov$,
  $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ "Status General": "Finalizat" }) }}$hov$::jsonb)

select id, "createdTime", fields from hov.at_project
where id = $hov${{ $("Create Project in Airtable").item.json.id }}$hov$

nodes.name: Resume Webhook
nodes.notes: POST {project_id} — restarts production for an existing project. Media Generation skips scenes that already have images/clips, so only missing work is regenerated.

parameters.query:
select id, "createdTime", fields from hov.at_project
where id = $hov${{ $json.body.project_id }}$hov$

select * from hov.at_write($hov$project$hov$, $hov${{ $('Fetch Project For Resume').first().json.id }}$hov$,
  $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ "Status General": "Finalizat" }) }}$hov$::jsonb)

nodes.name: Respond With Project
nodes.notes: Returns the freshly created Airtable project id so the site can redirect straight to the project page. Fails silently on form-trigger runs (no webhook to answer).

nodes.name: Restart Scripting Webhook
nodes.notes: The site posts {project_id} here when the writing phase died and there is nothing left to resume.

parameters.query:
select id, "createdTime", fields from hov.at_project
where id = $hov${{ $json.body.project_id }}$hov$

nodes.name: Prepare Restart Data
nodes.notes: Mirrors 'Prepare project data', but sourced from the existing record instead of the one the form just created.

nodes.name: Execute Scripting (Restart)
nodes.notes: Lore is empty on purpose: it arrives with the creation form and is never stored on the project, so a restart cannot recover it.

parameters.query:
select id, "createdTime", fields from hov.at_project
where id = $hov${{ $('Fetch Project For Restart').first().json.id }}$hov$

nodes.name: Mark Finished (Restart)
nodes.notes: No Lenght in the mapping - a mapped numeric field with no value writes a literal 0 and destroys the project length.

parameters.query:
select * from hov.at_write($hov$project$hov$, $hov${{ $('Fetch Project For Restart').first().json.id }}$hov$,
  $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ "Status General": "Finalizat" }) }}$hov$::jsonb)

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { try { if (!$('Normalize Webhook Input').isExecuted) return false; const r = $('Normalize Webhook Input').first().json.refImage; return !!(r && r.data); } catch (e) { return false; } })() }}
